source.check: the sixteen divisions and names read from the Larne Times report of the nominations (9 May 1936, p. 2), which states 'there would be no contest' and names each member declared elected

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, one for each of the sixteen electoral divisions. Nomination day was Wednesday 6 May 1936 and there was no contest in any division, the nominees being declared elected. Polling in County Antrim was fixed for 28 May 1936. Filed on 1936-06-04, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Antrim that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1936-05-28 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Huston; no nomination was received and he was deemed re-elected. Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
